story_type: fisherman losing feeling in his hands far off Oregon, basket hoist from a boat in white water, swimmer rides up last
hook: 25 miles off Oregon, he could barely breathe or feel his hands.
narration: Twenty-five miles off Oregon, a fisherman could barely breathe and was losing feeling in his hands.
He was aboard the fishing vessel Joseph, west of Tillamook Bay.
A Jayhawk crew from Sector North Bend lowered a rescue swimmer over the white water.
Before anyone goes up, the swimmer checks the patient on deck and settles him into the basket.
The basket swung down and landed on the deck.
[short pause] Then it came back up with the fisherman inside.
The swimmer rode the cable up last.
outcome: The aircrew got him ashore to medical personnel, who took him to Columbia Memorial Hospital.

location_card.place: 25 miles west of Tillamook Bay, Oregon

title: Fisherman hoisted 25 miles off Oregon
description:
On May 11, 2021, an MH-60 Jayhawk crew from Coast Guard Sector North Bend medevaced a fisherman from the commercial fishing vessel Joseph, 25 miles west of Tillamook Bay, Oregon, after he reported intense fatigue, difficulty breathing and loss of feeling in his hands and feet.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Sector Columbia River, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/794444
